title: Welcome
note: The light rises from the gate: the stacked lockup, one serif line of what the book is, one line about the voice, and "Your first two letters are free." (D-082). One button: Begin the book. ("I already have a book" and "I was invited" sit under it in builds with sign-in; this build has server features off, so both are hidden.)
text: The baby memory book you fill by talking. A few words at a time, in your own voice. Kept for your child to read and hear for years. Your first two letters are free. Begin the book
